result.instructions: Tools for MyOnlineStore, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many orders did my shop get this week, and what is their total?"; "Which articles are out of stock or changed in the last 7 days?"; "Show me the discount codes that are still active.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MyOnlineStore data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run myonlinestore_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run myonlinestore_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run myonlinestore_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. myonlinestore_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: myonlinestore_get_store
tools.title: Get store details
tools.description: Get the shop's own details: name, primary domain, currency, default and active languages, prices-include-tax setting and business models. Good first call to check the connection. GET /v1/store.

language.description: Language for translated fields (default: the shop language).

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_shipping_methods
tools.title: List shipping methods
tools.description: List the shipping methods the shop offers: display name, countries served, default flag and the free-shipping threshold. GET /v1/shipping/methods.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List the shop's articles (products) with name, SKU, price and stock. Filter by ids, uuids or created/changed dates. GET /v1/articles.

language.description: Language for translated fields (default: the shop language).

created_start_date.description: Date filter as the API expects it (for example 2026-01-31).

created_end_date.description: Date filter as the API expects it (for example 2026-01-31).

changed_start_date.description: Date filter as the API expects it (for example 2026-01-31).

changed_end_date.description: Date filter as the API expects it (for example 2026-01-31).

tools.name: myonlinestore_get_article
tools.title: Get an article
tools.description: Get one article (product) by its id. Set use_url_id to true when the id is the one shown in the article page URL. GET /v1/articles/{article_id}.

use_url_id.description: True when the id is the one from the article page URL (default false).

language.description: Language for translated fields (default: the shop language).
